terra.problem: The passage calls this a lamentation, but it does not say Amos sings it. The marked guess applies to why, not to whether he sings.
Saying the baker flipped the numbers assumes how they arrived at their answer.
Saying the pattern is stacked on purpose adds an intention the text does not state.
The warning not to seek or go to these places does not say people were actually heading there.
The burnt-tray comparison makes light of a warning of divine judgment and destruction.
The passage warns people not to seek Bethel, but does not say they had been going there.
The verse does not mention boundary stones, but that does not establish that nobody is touching any.
The verse names the remnant of Joseph; it does not say this means all that is left of Israel.
The verse does not say the farmer is working in a field when summoned, or that nobody gets to skip the mourning.
The verse summons the farmer to mourn, but does not say the wailing reaches into the fields.
